purpose: Supervised RGB semantic segmentation proposal; not MAPPO or driving-policy training

model.initialization: Load the original 19-class model strictly, preserve encoder and decoder features, replace only final classifier with a randomly initialized six-class classifier

dataset.split_unit: Whole scene-seed groups with disjoint road-layout families, procedural obstacle families and real pedestrian identities; one prepared vehicle base geometry is deliberately shared across splits
dataset.split_validation: Validate frame/source hashes, all-six-class support, group and family identity, exact RGB duplicates and recorded cross-split perceptual-neighbor review; shared vehicle geometry is an explicit exception
dataset.test_asset_pool: Tight S-bend road family, pyramid/low-cylinder obstacle family and male_adult_police_04 identity reserved before capture; prepared car geometry is shared, so vehicle-identity generalization is not tested
dataset.current_24_frames: qualitative regression only; already inspected; excluded from training, validation and held-out test
dataset.earlier_60_frame_smoke_set: pipeline evidence only; excluded from this proposed study
dataset.labels_note: Road retains drivable ID 1 but does not guarantee traversability. Dataset contains passenger cars, static rigged adult humans and procedural obstacles. Riders, bicycles and motorcycles are excluded and must be separately labeled/evaluated before adding them.
dataset.lidar_role: No LiDAR in this RGB dataset. Independent geometry/fusion regression remains on the earlier 24 saved frames; new-corpus LiDAR fusion and temporal motion compensation are separate future gates.
required_variation: one shared car visual at varied distances/relative poses
three real rigged pedestrian identities in static rest poses
dataset.minimum_class_presence: Each of the six classes must have reviewed nonzero support in all three splits; pedestrian proxies do not qualify
dataset.domain_limits: Procedural synthetic pilot, not photoreal roadway diversity; no animated pedestrian gait, unseen vehicle-identity test or real-world transfer evidence

preprocessing.geometry: No stretching or rescaling for 640x360 source; pad 12 pixels top and bottom to a multiple of 32
preprocessing.rgb_padding: Convert RGB to floating point and normalize first, then pad with exact floating-point zero; do not round ImageNet mean to uint8 padding colors
preprocessing.logits: Bilinear resize logits to padded input with align_corners=false; remove padding; compute loss/metrics at original resolution

loss.weighted_ce: Mean of -w[class]*log(p[class]) over valid pixels divided by mean valid-pixel weight, equivalent to weighted sum divided by sum of target weights
loss.class_weights: For train-only valid-pixel fractions f_c, raw=(max(f_c,0.001))^-0.5; divide raw by its six-class arithmetic mean, then clip to [0.25,4.0]; save exact weights. Fail if any training class is absent
loss.soft_dice: Average over classes 1..5 with GT support in the batch: 1-(2*sum(p*y)+1)/(sum(p)+sum(y)+1). No supported foreground class yields zero
loss.boundary_dice: For each class 1..5 compute 3x3 maxpool(p)-minpool(p), and same gradient on one-hot target; average 1-(2*sum(b_pred*b_gt)+1)/(sum(b_pred)+sum(b_gt)+1) over classes with GT boundary support
loss.boundary_domain: Exclude pixels whose 3x3 neighborhood touches ignored padding or the image border; do not manufacture boundaries at frame edges
loss.missing_class_policy: No absent-class reward in Dice averages; CE still penalizes false positive classes

optimization.schedule: Linear warmup from 0.1x to 1x LR for first 180 optimizer updates, then cosine decay to 0.1x at update 3600

budget.stop_rule: Stop at earliest epoch/update/loop-time cap or validation early stopping; save resumable state without automatically extending budget
budget.device: one GPU, serial with other Isaac/GPU work
budget.mixed_precision: fp16 with GradScaler, subject to finite-loss/memory preflight
budget.memory_fallback: If microbatch 4 fails preflight, use microbatch 2 and accumulation 8 and record the resolved configuration before authorization
budget.time_estimate: Measured resident-input compute-only extrapolation 39.79 seconds/epoch; excludes IO, augmentation, optimizer steps and checkpointing; not a completion promise
budget.wall_time_semantics: Two-hour cumulative training/validation-loop budget, checked between optimizer updates and validation batches; excludes initial dataset QA/model loading and allows one in-flight unit plus checkpoint-save overshoot

selection.primary_score: 0.5 * mean six-class IoU + 0.5 * mean road/vehicle boundary F1 at 2 pixels
selection.aggregation: Pool confusion/boundary counts within validation set before computing class metrics; all six classes required in validation
selection.tie_break: lower validation false-drivable rate, then earlier epoch
selection.test_use: Once after validation-only checkpoint selection; no thresholds or model selection from test results

evaluation.implementation_status: Six-class confusion/boundary/false-road validation implemented; instance matching, distance/size bins and motion-compensated temporal flicker remain follow-up evaluation gates and must not be claimed as measured
evaluation.false_drivable_rate_on_nonroad_gt: count(prediction==road AND GT not in {road,lane,ignore}) / count(GT not in {road,lane,ignore}); denominator includes obstacle, vehicle, pedestrian and background pixels; absent denominator is not evaluated
metrics: road and vehicle boundary precision/recall/F1 at 2px
false-drivable fraction over GT non-road non-lane pixels including obstacles
obstacle pixel recall by distance and projected size
object-level obstacle recall with explicit matching rule
temporal flicker with motion accounted for
CPU/GPU inference latency p50/p95 and peak memory
evaluation.obstacle_object_matching: Predicted obstacle connected component overlaps >=50% of a visible GT obstacle instance; separately report component IoU and unmatched prediction count. Instance annotations required; never infer identity from a semantic mask
evaluation.bin_convention: lower inclusive, upper exclusive; null is unbounded
evaluation.uncertainty: Scene-group bootstrap confidence intervals; one training seed cannot establish seed robustness
evaluation.target_status: Proposed, not achieved, not driving acceptance; review against dataset coverage before training and freeze without tuning to test results
evaluation.unknown_output: Deferred: current evaluation uses six-class argmax only. Max-softmax confidence export and validation-calibrated abstention are not implemented; uncalibrated softmax is not a safety probability.
baselines: same trained RGB plus independent LiDAR geometry
implemented_metrics: six-class confusion, IoU, precision and recall
road/vehicle boundary precision, recall and F1 at 2 pixels
false-drivable rate on non-road GT including obstacles
evaluation.metrics_scope: metrics and baselines list the full proposed evaluation roadmap; implemented_metrics and deferred_metrics define this milestone. No trained or held-out quality result exists yet.

deferred_evidence: raw versus LiDAR-fused fresh-corpus comparison (no LiDAR in new corpus)
